title: Threshold probability lower bound
statement: Let $G$ be a regular unique game, and let $I$ be a finite nonempty set. Suppose $v_i\in[0,1]$ for every $i\in I$, and let $\varepsilon\ge 0$ satisfy $\varepsilon<\frac{1}{|I|}\sum_{i\in I}v_i$. Then the fraction of indices $i\in I$ for which $v_i\ge\varepsilon/2$ is strictly greater than $\varepsilon/2$.
hypotheses_covered: The mean of the values is greater than $\varepsilon$
